experiment: Inkling 2 Mini, original 48 factual Cognee questions, corrected adaptive index
system_prompt: Answer using only the retrieved evidence. Preserve negation. Say unknown when the evidence does not establish the answer. Be concise (at most 120 words).

quality.reviewer: Codex post-run source review; not blinded human adjudication

rubric.method: All 48 answers read against frozen book gold spans; all retrieved contextual chunk appearances verified against actual reader requests, with additional prompt checks for facts outside gold spans.
rubric.q38_rubric: As in original assessment, score requested trigger and combat round; question uses a loose battle label and answer does not explicitly claim the worm helps the characters. Canonical source says the worm attacks the characters.
rubric.scope_review: Six item effect fragments correctly owned; Quickened rarity still incorrect in one graph description.

wording_sensitivity.reason: Misleading wording about Ruxithid mistaking mind flayers for gods can be read as reversing his belief.
wording_sensitivity.effect: One point if the awkward wording is interpreted as the intended source fact; no point is excluded.

qwen_checkpoint.quantization: NVFP4 experts and FP8 side layers

limits: One pass per frozen question, no repeated timing runs.
Same Qwen-ingested graph and summaries; no Inkling reingestion.
Models used different runtimes and tokenizers on shared devices at different times.
Latency covers retrieval and complete answer generation, not TTFT or inter-token latency.
No agent, follow-up retrieval, or action schema is involved.
Source review is separate from automatic provenance checks.
